jobs.name: gpu-info
jobs.command: nvidia-smi | tee gpu-info.txt && nvcc --version | tee -a gpu-info.txt

jobs.name: serial-build
jobs.command: set -o pipefail; g++ -std=c++17 -O2 -fPIC -shared -Iexperimental/duck_cuda/include experimental/duck_cuda/src/duck_cuda_serial.cpp -o libduck_cuda_serial.so 2>&1 | tee serial-build.log

jobs.name: gpu-parity
jobs.command: set -o pipefail; PY=$(command -v python3); $PY -c 'import numpy' 2>/dev/null || $PY -m pip install --quiet numpy; DUCK_CUDA_LIBRARY=$(find experimental/duck_cuda -name 'libduck_cuda.so' | head -1) DUCK_CUDA_SERIAL_LIBRARY=$PWD/libduck_cuda_serial.so $PY -B experimental/duck_cuda/tests/remote_gpu_parity.py 2>&1 | tee gpu-parity.log

jobs.name: gpu-bench
jobs.command: set -o pipefail; PY=$(command -v python3); $PY -c 'import numpy' 2>/dev/null || $PY -m pip install --quiet numpy; DUCK_CUDA_LIBRARY=$(find experimental/duck_cuda -name 'libduck_cuda.so' | head -1) DUCK_CUDA_FAST_LIBRARY=$(find experimental/duck_cuda -name 'libduck_cuda_fast.so' | head -1) $PY -B experimental/duck_cuda/tests/remote_gpu_bench.py 2>&1 | tee gpu-bench.log
